Source: the official AWS Architecture Icons package dated 2026-07-31:
https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/
https://d1.awsstatic.com/onedam/marketing-channels/website/public/shared/architecture-icon-release/Icon-package_07312026.5846e92413caa21490223536cc97f1269e44fa92.zip

AWS's architecture icons page states:
"We allow customers and partners to use these toolkits and assets to create
architecture diagrams."
"You can also put icons in materials like whitepapers, presentations, data
sheets, and posters."

KamoTrace uses the icons in its AWS configuration architecture diagrams and
their resource inspector. Files are unmodified SVGs, renamed locally:

| Local file | Path in the official package |
| --- | --- |
| ec2.svg | Architecture-Service-Icons_07312026/Arch_Compute/48/Arch_Amazon-EC2_48.svg |
| lambda.svg | Architecture-Service-Icons_07312026/Arch_Compute/48/Arch_AWS-Lambda_48.svg |
| rds.svg | Architecture-Service-Icons_07312026/Arch_Databases/48/Arch_Amazon-RDS_48.svg |
| elb.svg | Architecture-Service-Icons_07312026/Arch_Networking-Content-Delivery/48/Arch_Elastic-Load-Balancing_48.svg |
| vpc.svg | Architecture-Group-Icons_07312026/Virtual-private-cloud-VPC_32.svg |
| resource.svg | Architecture-Group-Icons_07312026/Server-contents_32.svg |

No endorsement by AWS is implied. No external assets are requested at runtime.
